Name: XdrLogRaider
Author: Alex Kefallonitis
Description:
**XdrLogRaider v0.1.0 GA** is a Microsoft Sentinel Solution that ingests **Defender XDR portal-only telemetry** — tenant security configuration, compliance posture, drift events, XSPM exposure, RBAC governance, and identity coverage — that is **not exposed by public Graph Security, Defender XDR, or MDE public APIs**.

The solution deploys a PowerShell 7.4 Azure Function App that authenticates as a dedicated service account (via Credentials+TOTP or Software Passkey) and polls Defender portal endpoints across **10 functional categories — 59 telemetry streams** — ingesting results into **11 consolidated Log Analytics tables** (10 `Defender_<Category>_CL` per category + 1 `XdrConnectorHealth_CL` ops table) in your Log Analytics workspace. Drift detection is computed in pure KQL via 4 cadence-tier parsers, feeding 8 workbooks and 20 analytic rules (14 detection + 6 XdrOps incl. RowVolumeSpike cost-budget gate).
WorkbookBladeDescription: 8 workbooks for security configuration compliance, drift tracking, RBAC governance, exposure mapping, identity posture, response audit, action center, and connector-health observability.
AnalyticalRuleBladeDescription: 20 scheduled analytic rules — 20 analytic rules for configuration drift and high-risk changes (Live Response policy relaxation, new data-export destinations, RBAC role assignments to unusual accounts, XSPM attack-path creation, tamper-protection disablement, MDI sensor down, etc.) plus 6 XdrOps rules (auth-chain failure, stream staleness, DLQ depth/age, row-volume spike cost-budget gate, service-account anomalous sign-in). All ship `enabled: false` per Microsoft Sentinel best practice.
HuntingQueryBladeDescription: 9 ad-hoc hunting queries for analyst-driven drift exploration, historical configuration investigation, and after-hours change attribution.
DataConnectorsBladeDescription: One data connector — XdrLogRaider — that authenticates to the Defender XDR portal using session cookies (sccauth + XSRF rotation) and publishes to 11 consolidated Log Analytics tables across 64 streams. v0.1.0 GA.
